answer_1.quote: we train and evaluate SQ-Transformer from scratch on multiple low-complexity semantic parsing and machine translation datasets requiring compositional generalization.
answer_1.outputs: parsed logical forms for semantic parsing, translated sentences for machine translation

answer_2.quote: In semantic parsing, SQ-Transformer improves upon Transformer on SCAN ADDJUMP x2 (40%→99.4%), AROUNDRIGHT (69.5%→99.6%), and COGS (82.6%→83.4%). In machine translation, SQ-Transformer achieves higher BLEU scores (60.5→62.8) and lower novel compound translation error (29.6%→18.1%) on CoGnition.
